stories.title: Mila Plastic Industry removes metal from trigger sprayers
stories.summary: Mila Plastic Industry has introduced an all-polypropylene trigger sprayer range to eliminate metal components. The company says brands want bottle and head handled as one plastic stream at end of life. Every metal component inside the head is now described as a design problem.

stories.title: BW Packaging updates Hayssen X650 flow wrapper
stories.summary: BW Packaging has launched the Hayssen X650 flow wrapper. The machine is designed to provide hermetic sealing, a hygienic build, and simplified operation for applications where seal integrity is considered critical.

stories.title: Airless packaging market reaches 6.4 billion dollars
stories.summary: The airless packaging market grew from 6.05 billion dollars in 2025 to 6.4 billion dollars in 2026. The sector is expanding at a compound annual growth rate of 5.8 percent, driven by consumer preferences and technology intended to enhance product preservation.

stories.title: Polypropylene corrugated packaging market sees growth
stories.summary: The global polypropylene corrugated packaging market is experiencing expansion as industries seek protective and sustainable solutions. A new report forecasts trends and growth drivers for the sector through 2035. The market is currently navigating evolving demands across various global industries.

stories.title: Flexible plastic packaging market projected to hit 310 billion dollars
stories.summary: The global flexible plastic packaging market is expected to grow from 194 billion dollars in 2026 to 310 billion dollars by 2036. Stand-up pouches are forecast to remain the leading format, accounting for 48 percent of demand in 2026.

stories.title: Plastic food storage market enters 2026 with new procurement focus
stories.summary: The global plastic food storage market enters 2026 with more disciplined procurement behavior and a regionally diversified supply architecture. The category remains characterized by intense competition between established brands and private-label programs, with demand bifurcating into price-sensitive and premium segments.

stories.title: Metalized flexible packaging market expands
stories.summary: The metalized flexible packaging sector has experienced swift expansion in recent years. The market is evolving as innovations and shifting consumer needs shape its trajectory. Industry participants are currently analyzing segment trends and key driving factors to understand the expanding landscape.

stories.title: Thermoformed plastics market navigates regulatory pressures
stories.summary: The global thermoformed plastics market enters 2026 with broader demand fundamentals and a more regionally diversified supply architecture. The industry is currently navigating a complex landscape defined by evolving regulatory pressures and the ongoing need for cost-effective packaging solutions.

stories.title: Daily round-up: Indian polymer prices remain mixed, China capacity expansion adds supply pressure - BigMint
Indian automotive supply chain faces margin pressure
stories.summary: Indian automotive manufacturers and tier-1 suppliers are reporting intense margin pressures due to commodity inflation and currency depreciation. Hot-rolled and cold-rolled steel prices have surged over 33 percent year-on-year, while copper costs have climbed 35.9 percent.

China consumer inflation moderates to 0.7 percent
stories.summary: China’s consumer inflation rose 0.7 percent year-on-year in October, falling short of market expectations. While food prices moderated, producer price inflation strengthened. The country continues to see robust export growth amid the global artificial intelligence boom.

stories.title: D2C brands consider price hikes amid rising material costs
stories.summary: Direct-to-consumer brands are rethinking pricing and packaging strategies to protect margins following a year of input cost hikes. Sectors including beauty, personal care, and packaging have been affected by sharp increases in the price of plastic raw materials.

stories.title: PureCycle demonstrates recycling technology at PepsiCo hub
stories.summary: PureCycle Technologies presented its dissolution recycling process at PepsiCo's Sustainability Innovation Hub. The demonstration highlighted the use of PureFive resin in polypropylene packaging for the food and beverage sector.

stories.title: Biodegradable plastic study finds limited breakdown in landfills
stories.summary: Researchers from the Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology and Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology tested three biodegradable plastics in landfill conditions. The study found that some materials failed to break down over 320 days. Plastic is designed to last, even when it is not.

stories.title: Recycled PET price parity in Mexico remains tied to geopolitics
stories.summary: Recycled PET has reached price parity with virgin resin in Mexico due to rising oil prices and conflict in the Middle East. High collection costs and a lack of structural recycling economics mean the parity remains dependent on global instability rather than local market shifts.

stories.title: PureCycle joins PepsiCo sustainability innovation hub
stories.summary: PureCycle Technologies participated in the second edition of the PepsiCo Sustainability Innovation Hub in Mexico City. The company, which describes itself as revolutionizing plastic recycling, engaged in problem-solving sessions regarding packaging challenges. PepsiCo uses the hub to connect with external innovators for its sustainability teams.

stories.title: From gas pipes to hog farms, industrial castoffs find new purpose - Plastics News
Eurokey opens 20 million pound plastic recycling plant in UK
stories.summary: Eurokey has opened a 20 million pound recycling facility in Northamptonshire to process plastic packaging from supermarkets and retailers. The plant adds 38,000 tonnes of annual capacity to the UK market. The facility aims to convert used plastic into pellets for new packaging manufacturing.

stories.title: Fire at Adampur Chhawani recycling plant causes local health concerns
stories.summary: A fire at a plastic recycling plant in Adampur Chhawani destroyed five tonnes of material and released smoke across nearby villages. Residents reported breathing difficulties and eye irritation as fumes spread. Four fire tenders were dispatched to address the blaze.

stories.title: Washington state fines firms $250K for not using recycled plastic - Plastics News
Eurokey opens plastic recycling plant in the UK to boost domestic circularity - Plastics News
Clean Recycle launches platform for European packaging regulation
stories.summary: Clean Recycle is launching a digital platform to help companies comply with the European Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation. The tool assists businesses in assessing packaging design and material composition. The regulation extends compliance obligations across the entire life cycle of packaging.

stories.title: Textile waste volumes continue to rise
stories.summary: The global fashion industry sends the equivalent of one garbage truck of clothing to landfill or incineration every second. Despite increasing awareness of textile waste volumes, current infrastructure struggles to manage the output. The industry continues to produce at a rate that outpaces current disposal methods.

stories.title: EU packaging regulation impacts flexible packaging
stories.summary: The EU packaging regulation now applies across all member states. Secondary legislation is currently being developed to clarify how flexible packaging will meet requirements for PFAS compliance, recyclability, and recycled content. The rules are being written while the regulation is already in effect.

stories.title: Frugalpac warns of glass exemption impact on packaging
stories.summary: The UK government will exempt glass drink containers sold to hospitality venues from disposal fees starting April 2027. Frugalpac CEO Malcolm Waugh warned that the government must not confuse making glass cheaper with making packaging greener. The policy aims to prevent businesses from paying double for waste.

stories.title: UK packaging EPR fees spark manufacturing concerns - Packaging Gateway
REUSE Foundation criticizes 2030 Plastics Agenda
stories.summary: The REUSE Foundation argues the 2030 Plastics Agenda may repeat the failures of the Global Commitment, which saw signatories miss targets since 2018. An independent review suggests the framework requires a shift toward reuse strategies to be effective. The previous plan did not meet its goals.

stories.title: UK exempts glass bottles in hospitality from EPR fees
stories.summary: The UK government has introduced Extended Producer Responsibility exemptions for licensed venues buying glass drink containers. The move is intended to save businesses up to 10p per wine bottle by avoiding double-charging. The government is also consulting on further waste fees for the industry.

stories.title: Packaging EPR rules increase pressure on companies to improve data accuracy - Packaging Gateway
Paper tray box market grows alongside e-commerce
stories.summary: The global paper tray box market is expanding due to e-commerce growth and a pivot away from plastic packaging. IndexBox reports that the market enters 2026 with more disciplined procurement behavior and a diversified supply architecture. Regulatory frameworks continue to drive demand for sustainable transport solutions.

stories.title: Life Water introduces paper-based bottle
stories.summary: Life Water has launched a 500ml water bottle made from wood fibre in partnership with Pulpex. The company intends to challenge conventional bottled water formats by using material designed for existing paper recycling streams. The bottle is part of a strategy to reduce the impact of packaging.

stories.title: Pulpex secures £19.6m investment for Glasgow facility
stories.summary: The National Wealth Fund has invested £19.6 million in Pulpex, alongside £4.4 million from the Scottish National Investment Bank. The funding aims to accelerate the company’s growth and deploy its fibre bottle technology through a global licensing network. The facility is now officially open for business.

stories.title: Life Water debuts paper bottle with Pulpex
stories.summary: Life Water has launched a water bottle made from wood fibre using Pulpex moulded-fibre technology. The company says it believes packaged water should do better and is proud to offer a product designed to be recycled as paper. Nature is now a renewable resource for hydration.

stories.title: Flexible paper packaging market sees growth
stories.summary: The flexible paper packaging sector is expanding as it adapts to shifting consumer preferences and sustainability demands. The market is currently experiencing significant momentum, with industry analysts positioning the sector to shape the future of packaging solutions through innovative advancements and rapid expansion in the coming years.

stories.title: Shellworks develops compostable VIVOMER material
stories.summary: Shellworks has developed VIVOMER, a material derived from plant waste that functions like conventional plastic. It is compatible with existing injection and blow moulding machines, allowing manufacturers to produce bottles and jars without replacing production lines. The material is designed to survive washing and eventually feed the soil.

stories.title: Fiber-based bottle market projected to reach $9.20 billion
stories.summary: The global fiber-based bottle packaging market is valued at $4.80 billion in 2026, up from $4.51 billion the previous year. Future Market Insights projects the market will grow at a 6.7% CAGR to reach $9.20 billion by 2036. The industry expects to add $4.40 billion in revenue.

stories.title: Paper carrier bag market growth forecast at 3.8%
stories.summary: The global paper carrier bag market is expected to expand at a 3.8% CAGR through 2028. Demand is driven by regulatory scrutiny of single-use plastics and a preference for recyclable packaging. The industry report does not provide specific market valuation figures for the forecast period.

stories.title: Shellworks promotes home-compostable biomaterial
stories.summary: Shellworks is marketing Vivomer, a biomaterial that is waterproof, food-safe, and dishwasher-friendly. The company claims the material is entirely bio-based and compostable at home over several months. It is intended to reduce reliance on fossil-fuel-based plastics that persist in landfills for eons.

stories.title: Ixapack Global introduces robotic case packer
stories.summary: Ixapack Global has launched a case packer featuring delta robots for high-speed pick-and-place operations. The system includes tool-free format changes and an optimized case closing mechanism. It is capable of reaching speeds of up to 25 cases per minute.

stories.title: Regal Rexnord updates can pattern-forming system
stories.summary: Regal Rexnord has released the Busse Variable Pattern Rite System, which uses a tool-less mechanism to handle multiple can diameters. The company says the system reduces changeover downtime, floor space requirements, and labor costs by allowing various configurations from a single setup.

stories.title: High-Speed Food Packaging Systems: ULMA Fast Skin Increases Tray Sealing Efficiency - Trend Hunter
Impact Packaging adds rigid box-making equipment
stories.summary: Mumbai-based Impact Packaging has installed new rigid box-making and V-grooving machines from SASG UV Solutions. Proprietor Vaibhav Salunke described the equipment as compact and versatile, noting that the machines allow the company to produce a variety of box designs to meet diverse customer requirements.

stories.title: SOMIC highlights diagnostic tools for cartoning
stories.summary: SOMIC is promoting its 202 cartoning machine alongside its Eagle camera-based troubleshooting system and Connect digital service. The company says these tools help operators identify equipment faults and share diagnostic data with technicians to reduce production downtime.

stories.title: Maintenance strategies for aging packaging equipment
stories.summary: Industry guidance suggests that packaging equipment can maintain peak operational efficiency through strategic retrofits and regular maintenance. The approach focuses on keeping older machinery functional to avoid the costs associated with full system replacements.

stories.title: Interpack China 2026 focuses on automation
stories.summary: Manufacturers at Interpack China 2026 are highlighting automated and energy-efficient machinery. Exhibitors including Somic, Bobst, and Tederic are showcasing technologies designed to improve production flexibility and reduce operating costs. The event runs from 16 to 18 November in Shanghai.

stories.title: ULMA launches high-speed skin traysealer
stories.summary: ULMA Packaging has introduced the TSX 875 traysealer featuring Fast Skin technology. The company claims the system enables film to adapt to product contours at speeds of up to 13 cycles per minute. It is designed to increase output while maintaining pack aesthetics for food manufacturers.

stories.title: Korbel updates brand identity and packaging
stories.summary: Korbel California Champagne is introducing a refreshed brand identity and new packaging across its sparkling wine portfolio. The company says the campaign is inspired by the idea of uncomplicating good times, noting that the brand has been part of American celebrations since 1882.

stories.title: Target links food growth to packaging
stories.summary: At the PLMA trade show, Target’s food division leadership identified packaging as a primary driver for growth. The retailer is placing increased focus on the role of product containers in its food strategy.

stories.title: Consumer goods prices rise after Diwali
stories.summary: Consumer goods companies are increasing prices for smartphones, televisions, and refrigerators following the Diwali festive season. Manufacturers are citing rising input costs and the need to protect profit margins. Retailers are also reducing product grammage to recover costs. Household budgets are expected to tighten accordingly.

stories.title: Wendy's launches holiday blind boxes
stories.summary: Wendy's has introduced a holiday meal box containing one of four collectible retro knit hats in a blind bag. The packaging is inspired by the chain's glass-walled Solarium dining rooms. The promotion includes a two-day New York pop-up event. The hats are now available at participating U.S. restaurants.

stories.title: E-commerce packaging market forecast to reach US$360.6 billion
stories.summary: Persistence Market Research values the global e-commerce packaging market at US$121.6 billion for 2026. The firm forecasts the market will reach US$360.6 billion by 2033, representing a 16.8% annual growth rate. Retailers are currently balancing packing speed, material recovery, and product protection to manage rising freight expenses.

stories.title: Appliance and smartphone makers raise prices
stories.summary: Samsung, Xiaomi, Haier, and Godrej have increased prices on handsets, tablets, and appliances by up to 18 percent. Companies report that elevated raw material costs are impacting profitability despite healthy sales growth. The industry previously implemented a broad price increase in September. Profits are taking a hit.

stories.title: Health conscious consumers to Soft drinks shoppers want low calorie options
stories.summary: The UK soft drinks and bottled waters sector is driven by surging health consciousness, strong performance in low- and no-calorie options, premiumisation, and expanding hospitality sales. More than 70% of soft drinks sold in the UK are low- or no-calorie, driven by consumers actively reducing sugar, ultra-processed food (UPF) consumption,

Vinsak’s value-added converting solutions at Loupe India 2026
stories.summary: At the Loupe India show in Greater Noida, Vinsak India highlighted growing interest in high-end label embellishment and specialty converting solutions, reporting strong footfall and customer engagement. Speaking on the sidelines of the event, Ranesh Bajaj, director, Vinsak, shared insights on market shifts, product performance, and press demand while addressing

stories.title: TCPL Packaging forms joint venture with Brandart
stories.summary: TCPL Packaging Limited has entered a joint venture with Italy-based Brandart S.p.A. to expand packaging operations in the Asia-Pacific region. The partnership will operate through a new Singapore-based company. Brandart provides global services in retail installations, visual merchandising, and packaging. The venture aims to establish a stronger regional presence.

stories.title: Field Packaging Solutions acquires Buckeye Packaging
stories.summary: Field Packaging Solutions has acquired Buckeye Packaging Co., a flexible packaging manufacturer based in Ohio. The transaction closed on November 2, 2026. Buckeye was founded in 1948 by a high school chemistry teacher who built a machine to make polyethylene bags. Terms of the deal were not disclosed.

stories.title: Specialty chemicals startup altM raises $10.3 million
stories.summary: Specialty chemicals startup altM has raised $10.3 million in Series A funding led by Rainmatter and Mela Ventures. The company plans to use the capital to expand manufacturing capacity and commercialise bio-based industrial chemicals. The investment supports the firm's transition from research to larger-scale engineering and commercial operations.

stories.title: Enjay Converters to acquire New Method Packaging
stories.summary: Enjay Converters Ltd. has announced the acquisition of Ohio-based New Method Packaging. Founded in 1982, New Method manufactures custom corrugated and paper-based food packaging, including cake circles and carryout boxes. Financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed. The company serves bakery and pizza markets across the U.S.

stories.title: MM Group sells packaging business for €2.4 billion
stories.summary: MM Group has agreed to sell its Food, Premium, Pharma, and Healthcare packaging operations to KPS Capital Partners at an enterprise value of €2.4 billion. KPS will hold 70 percent of the new holding company, with MM Group retaining 30 percent. The deal excludes operations in Iran and Tunisia.

stories.title: Wind Point Partners Acquires Chroma Color Corp.
stories.summary: Wind Point Partners has acquired Chroma Color Corporation from Arsenal Capital Partners, positioning the custom color and additive formulator for continued acquisitions and technology-driven growth.
